title: When does adjustment stop?
hook: Two stated cases: explore the remaining distance after repeated adjustment.

knows: Reading the stated arithmetic assumptions and a small numerical chart
doesNotKnow: How the remaining distance after repeated adjustment affects the stated comparison

misconception: The headline alone determines Estimate, regardless of the stated inputs.
objective: Compare the remaining distance after repeated adjustment in two explicit finite cases; separate model arithmetic from an empirical population claim.
